title: Home loads hero and featured collections
description: Verifies the home page renders primary brand hero content and featured product sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the hero section with brand visuals is displayed
Verify featured product collection sections are displayed

title: Home navigation to Shop shows product listing
description: Verifies primary navigation from Home to Shop and that the shop grid loads.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the navigation link to go to the shop
Verify the shop product grid is displayed

title: Home slide-out cart opens and shows empty state when no items
description: Verifies the slide-out cart panel opens from the navbar and shows an empty cart state when there are no items.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the cart icon to open the cart panel
Verify an empty cart state is displayed

title: Shop loads product grid
description: Verifies the shop page loads and displays a browsable grid of products.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Verify the shop product grid is displayed

title: Filter by category leads to a filtered listing view
description: Verifies category filtering from the shop results in a filtered product listing view.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Click a category to filter products
Verify a filtered product listing is displayed

title: Open product details, view carousel, add to cart, and see cart updated
description: Verifies the end-to-end flow from shop to product details, viewing images, adding to cart, and seeing the cart reflect the added item.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Click on a product card to view its details
Interact with the product images carousel to view another image
Add the product to the cart
Click the cart icon to open the cart panel
Verify the cart shows at least one item

title: Toggle wishlist state from product detail
description: Verifies the wishlist heart icon can be toggled on a product detail page.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Click on a product card to view its details
Click the wishlist heart icon to toggle wishlist on
Click the wishlist heart icon to toggle wishlist off
Verify the wishlist indicator reflects the item is not wishlisted

title: Shop search or filter with no matches shows empty results state
description: Verifies that applying filters or search resulting in no matches shows an empty results state.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Fill text into the search field that is unlikely to match any product
Press Enter
Verify an empty results state is displayed

title: Cart page shows items and quantity controls update totals
description: Verifies cart items display with quantity controls and the total updates when quantity changes, then proceeds to checkout.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Click on a product card to view its details
Add the product to the cart
Navigate to /cart
Click the increase quantity control for the cart item
Click Proceed to Checkout
Verify the checkout/payment form is displayed

title: Remove items until cart is empty and checkout is blocked
description: Verifies removing items from the cart leads to an empty cart state and prevents proceeding to checkout.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Click on a product card to view its details
Add the product to the cart
Navigate to /cart
Remove the item from the cart
Verify an empty cart message is displayed
Verify the checkout action is disabled or unavailable

title: Complete checkout from payment form to thank you confirmation
description: Verifies a user can enter shipping and payment details and submit the order to reach the on-site confirmation page.

steps.description: Navigate to /payment
Fill John into the first name field
Fill Doe into the last name field
Fill john.doe@example.com into the email address field
Fill a valid shipping address into the shipping address fields
Fill a valid card number into the card number field
Fill a valid expiry date into the expiry date field
Fill a valid CVV into the CVV field
Submit the payment form
Verify the user lands on the thank you page
Verify an order confirmation is visible

title: Payment page loads and displays checkout form
description: Verifies the payment page primary checkout content is available to start an order.

steps.description: Navigate to /payment
Verify shipping details inputs are displayed
Verify payment details inputs are displayed

title: Prevent submission when required fields are missing
description: Verifies validation errors appear and the user is not taken to confirmation when required fields are incomplete.

steps.description: Navigate to /payment
Fill John into the first name field
Fill Doe into the last name field
Submit the payment form
Verify form validation errors are visible
Verify the user remains on the payment page

title: Email validation blocks invalid email format
description: Verifies entering an invalid email shows a validation error and prevents order submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /payment
Fill John into the first name field
Fill Doe into the last name field
Fill invalid-email into the email address field
Fill a valid shipping address into the shipping address fields
Fill a valid card number into the card number field
Fill a valid expiry date into the expiry date field
Fill a valid CVV into the CVV field
Submit the payment form
Verify an email validation error is visible
Verify the user remains on the payment page

title: Card number validation blocks invalid card number
description: Verifies an invalid card number triggers validation and prevents navigation to confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /payment
Fill John into the first name field
Fill Doe into the last name field
Fill john.doe@example.com into the email address field
Fill a valid shipping address into the shipping address fields
Fill 1234 into the card number field
Fill a valid expiry date into the expiry date field
Fill a valid CVV into the CVV field
Submit the payment form
Verify a payment card validation error is visible
Verify the user remains on the payment page

title: Thank you page loads directly and shows confirmation content
description: Verifies the order confirmation page can render its primary confirmation content.

steps.description: Navigate to /thankyou
Verify an order confirmation is visible
Verify a post-purchase next-step action is available

title: Account page loads and shows profile section
description: Verifies the account overview displays the primary profile content.

steps.description: Navigate to /account
Verify the account profile section is displayed
Verify account navigation tabs are displayed

title: Open wishlist tab and remove an item (when available)
description: Verifies a user can remove an item from the wishlist and the list updates accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /account
Open the wishlist tab
If the wishlist is empty, add a product to the wishlist from the shop and return to the wishlist tab
Remove an item from the wishlist
Verify the removed item is no longer displayed in the wishlist
Verify the wishlist count or list updates accordingly

title: Wishlist empty state after clearing browser storage
description: Verifies the wishlist shows an empty state when no items are saved.

steps.description: Navigate to /account
Clear the site data using the app’s clear/reset control if available
Open the wishlist tab
Verify an empty wishlist state is visible

title: Navigate to order history from account
description: Verifies the user can reach order history from the account page navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /account
Navigate to the order history tab
Verify past orders are displayed or an empty state is visible

title: Search page loads and shows search input and results area
description: Verifies the product search page primary content is available for searching.

steps.description: Navigate to /search
Verify a search input is displayed
Verify a search results area is displayed

title: Search returns filtered results and opens a product detail
description: Verifies searching by keyword filters results and selecting a result shows product details.

steps.description: Navigate to /search
Fill espresso into the search input field
Wait for the results to update
Select a product from the search results
Verify product details are displayed

title: Search with no matches shows empty state
description: Verifies a query with no matching products shows a no-results state.

steps.description: Navigate to /search
Fill zzznonexistentproductzzz into the search input field
Wait for the results to update
Verify a no results state is visible

title: Clear search query restores broader results or default state
description: Verifies clearing the search input returns the UI to a non-filtered state.

steps.description: Navigate to /search
Fill espresso into the search input field
Wait for the results to update
Clear the search input field
Wait for the results to update
Verify multiple products are displayed or a default search state is visible

title: Events listing page loads and shows upcoming events
description: Verifies the Events listing page renders a list of upcoming events users can browse.

steps.description: Navigate to /events
Verify a list of upcoming events is displayed

title: Book an event from listing through detail and see confirmation
description: Verifies a user can open an event detail, complete the booking form, submit, and see a booking confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /events
Click on an event card to view event detail
Click the booking action to open the booking form
Fill in the name field with Event Booker
Fill in the email field with event.booker@example.com
Select a valid number of attendees
Submit the booking form
Verify a local booking confirmation is visible

title: Event booking validation prevents submission with missing required fields
description: Verifies booking form required-field validation blocks submission and shows validation errors.

steps.description: Navigate to /events
Click on an event card to view event detail
Click the booking action to open the booking form
Fill in the name field with Event Booker
Fill in the email field with event.booker@example.com
Fill in the attendees field with empty value
Submit the booking form
Verify a validation error is visible and booking is not confirmed

title: Event detail shows key information after selecting an event
description: Verifies event detail view displays essential event information after navigating from listing.

steps.description: Navigate to /events
Click on an event card to view event detail
Verify the event description, date, and location are displayed

title: Booking form opens from event detail
description: Verifies the booking form can be opened from an event detail view.

steps.description: Navigate to /events
Click on an event card to view event detail
Click the booking action to open the booking form
Verify the booking form fields for name, email, and attendees are displayed

title: Contact page loads and displays contact form
description: Verifies the Contact page renders the contact form with required fields.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Verify the contact form fields for name, email, and message are displayed

description: Verifies a user can complete the contact form and receive an on-page success confirmation.

Fill in the name field with Contact Tester
Fill in the email field with contact.tester@example.com
Fill in the message field with This is a test message for the contact form.
Submit the contact form
Verify a success confirmation message is visible

title: Contact form validation prevents submission when required fields are empty
description: Verifies required-field validation blocks contact form submission and shows validation errors.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Submit the contact form

Scroll down the story page

description: Ensures the reviews page renders a list of review cards with rating and comment content.

steps.description: Navigate to /reviews
Wait for the reviews content to load
Verify customer review cards are displayed
Verify each displayed review card shows a rating and a written comment

title: Scroll through the reviews list
description: Verifies the user can scroll the reviews list to see additional reviews.

Wait for the reviews content to load
Scroll down the page
Scroll further down the page
Verify additional review cards are visible after scrolling

steps.description: Navigate to /reviews
Wait for the reviews content to load
Verify an empty state message is visible indicating no reviews are available

title: Reviews page remains usable when scrolling to the bottom
description: Verifies the reviews page continues to render content without breaking after significant scrolling.

steps.description: Navigate to /reviews
Wait for the reviews content to load
Scroll to the bottom of the page
Verify the page remains responsive and review content is still displayed

title: Social gallery page loads and shows photo card grid
description: Ensures the social gallery renders a grid of Instagram-style photo cards.

steps.description: Navigate to /social
Wait for the gallery content to load
Verify a grid of social photo cards is displayed
Verify multiple photo thumbnails are visible

title: Open a social photo for larger view when supported
description: Verifies clicking a photo opens a larger view overlay/modal or detail view when implemented.

steps.description: Navigate to /social
Wait for the gallery content to load
Click a photo card in the gallery
Verify a larger photo view is displayed

description: Verifies the user can dismiss the larger photo view and continue browsing the gallery.

steps.description: Navigate to /social
Wait for the gallery content to load
Click a photo card in the gallery
Press Escape
Verify the gallery grid is visible and the larger photo view is no longer displayed

title: Social gallery shows fallback visuals for missing images
description: Verifies the UI provides a placeholder or fallback visual when an image cannot be displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /social
Wait for the gallery content to load
Verify photo cards render visible placeholders or fallback visuals for any images that do not display

title: Terms page loads with table of contents and sections
description: Ensures the terms page renders primary legal content with a table of contents for navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /terms
Wait for the terms content to load
Verify terms sections are displayed
Verify a table of contents navigation area is displayed

description: Verifies clicking a table of contents item scrolls/jumps the page to the corresponding section.

Wait for the terms content to load
Click a table of contents link for a specific section
Verify the page view jumps to the corresponding terms section

title: Scroll through terms sections to read content
description: Verifies the terms content is scrollable and continues to render across sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /terms
Wait for the terms content to load
Scroll down the page
Scroll further down the page
Verify additional terms sections are visible after scrolling

title: Table of contents handles missing anchors gracefully
description: Verifies clicking a table of contents item that does not have a matching section does not break the page and results in a safe fallback position.

Wait for the terms content to load
Click a table of contents link that does not navigate to a visible corresponding section
Verify the page remains usable and does not navigate to a broken or blank state
